name: Train Departures
description: The next direct NMBS/SNCB train on your route with its delay and platform (08:14 +12 P4), plus the one after, live from iRail.
author: Alvin To

from_station.title: From station
from_station.description: Where you board. Pick from the list or type an iRail station name in Dutch, French, English or German (e.g. Gent-Sint-Pieters).

to_station.title: To station
to_station.description: Where you get off. Only direct trains (no transfers) are shown.

from_label.title: From label
from_label.description: Short board name for the from station (e.g. GENT). Empty: the station's name, cut to 15 characters.

to_label.title: To label
to_label.description: Short board name for the to station (e.g. BRUSSEL-C). Empty: the station's name, cut to 15 characters.

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh Interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often to ask iRail for new times (minimum 30 seconds).

status.description: OK, NO TRAIN DATA (iRail unreachable) or NO DIRECT TRAIN; the train fields are empty unless OK

route.description: From and to label as FROM>TO, cut to 15

from_label.description: Board label of the from station (setting, else the station's name)

to_label.description: Board label of the to station (setting, else the station's name)

time.description: Scheduled departure (HH:MM, local time) of the next direct train that has not left

delay.description: Delay of that train in whole minutes (+12); empty when on time

platform.description: Departure platform of that train (P4); empty when unknown

next_time.description: Scheduled departure of the following direct train; empty if none

next_delay.description: Delay of the following train (+3); empty when on time or none
